messages.author: 3482b9c7f0135672
messages.subject: Professional version of shinyapps.io
parts:
Our organization is considering purchasing the professional version of shinyapps.io, but have a few questions.

1) Once authentication is placed on our application, will the users still see the shinyapps.io writing on the login page (above the username and password) or will we have the flexibility to change that to a name of our choice?

2) If we use a custom domain, https:// security disappears. Would we able to place a certification and maintain the application's functionality?

3) In the event that the servers hosting our application goes down, what is the time frame for expected turnaround? 

4) Lastly, if we exceed 10,000 hours per month, what would overage charges look like? Can we buy 2 professional packages (10,000 hours per month) packages and apply it to the same account?

Thank you.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Professional version of shinyapps.io
parts:
1) Yes you will. We do not currently offer a branded authentication experience.

2) With a custom domain, the outer page is not fetched with HTTPS, that is correct. However, that page contains an inner iframe that is loaded over HTTPS. You are certainly welcome to host your own proxy server with an SSL certificate you manage. We do have it on our roadmap to use LetsEncrypt to generate certificates for custom domains, but no timeframe to convey at this time.

3) There is no SLA covering shinyapps.io, but we monitor the servers and have an on-call rotation and maintain a status page.

4) While we reserve the right to begin charging overages for exceeding hours, we are currently not doing so. Should that change, there will be plenty of notice communicated.
